cluster_summary: This cluster comprises various cryptographic implementation errors including missing validation of cryptographic operation results and input parameters, carry propagation bugs in arithmetic, side-channel leakage due to non-constant-time code, integer overflow, default insecure modes, and improper order of operations. These flaws lead to predictable keys, oracle attacks, keystream reuse, and out-of-bounds access.
guideline_text: Trace attacker-influenced inputs, resource identities, state values, or configuration described by the member CVEs into the sensitive operation or security boundary described by the member CVEs. Report code paths where the required validation, authorization, isolation, state check, or binding is absent or not connected to the sensitive effect. Confirm that the guard is enforced before the sensitive effect and remains bound to the same resource, principal, destination, or object that the effect uses. Treat this as a reusable mechanism-level pattern derived from 1 historical CVE example(s), not as a project-specific signature. A safe implementation should Compute iteration count inside the prime generation loop using the actual bit length of the candidate (x.bitLength()) instead of a precomputed value based on key strength..

sub_patterns.name: Insufficient primality test rounds due to incorrect parameter selection
sub_patterns.root_cause: Number of Miller-Rabin primality test iterations is computed using key strength parameter instead of the actual bit length of the candidate prime, resulting in insufficient rounds for smaller primes.
